comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: head of household with a qualifying child - deduction 23,625, tax 2,615 = hoh table at the 24,625 midpoint (1,700 + 12% of 7,625), minus the 2,200 CTC = 415; overpaid 5,585. The engine's own eligibility answer (/eligibleForHoh) is TRUE on this return; the post-resolve gate serves it because of that, and refuses when it is not. Re-blessed with the earned income credit 345 now computes and joins line 33 (was 6,000, now 6,345; line 34 5,585 -> 5,930) — hand-checked against the 2025 EITC table for one qualifying child: 4,328 - 15.98% x (48,275 bracket midpoint - 23,350) = 345. Earlier, the EITC gate facts (Form 8862, qualifying child of another) were unanswered, the chain resolved Placeholder and the credit was a placeholder 0 — the refundable-side twin of the Form 8960 understatement.
